name: Microsoft 365 Password Change Requests with Approval, Entra ID Reset & Dynamics 365 Ticketing

parameters.content:
## Microsoft 365 password change, with approval and ticketing

**What it does**
1. A user submits the form. The request is logged in a data table and a Dynamics 365 case is opened.
2. The admin and the user are emailed the ticket number.
3. The user is looked up in Entra ID and checked for a registered Microsoft Authenticator and an enabled account.
4. The admin gets Approve / Decline buttons by email (24-hour limit).
5. On approval, a temporary password is set that requires MFA before the user picks a new one, and is emailed to the user's alternate address.
6. Whatever the outcome, the case gets a note, is resolved and closed in Dynamics 365, and the admin and user are emailed the result.

**Setup**
1. **Credentials:** add your own to every node that needs one: Microsoft Outlook (the mailbox that sends the emails), Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft OAuth2 (Graph, for the Authenticator check), and Microsoft Dynamics OAuth2.
2. **Data table:** create a table with these string columns: `full_name`, `work_email`, `reason`, `comments`, `submitted_at`, `status`, `dynamics_ticket`, `dynamics_case_id`, `decided_at`. Select it in all six data table nodes.
3. **Dynamics Settings node:** set your org URL, a fallback account GUID (used when no contact matches the email), and the admin / helpdesk email.
4. **Permissions:** the Entra / Graph account must be allowed to read users, read authentication methods, and reset passwords (for example a Helpdesk or User Administrator with User.ReadWrite.All and UserAuthenticationMethod.Read.All).
5. **Test:** run each path once (approve, decline, a user without Authenticator, an unknown email) before activating.

**Customise**
Form text, email wording, the 24-hour approval window (Ask Admin for Approval) and the Dynamics resolution status codes (5 / 1000 in the Outcome nodes).

parameters.formDescription: Use this form to request a change to your Microsoft 365 password. Your request goes to IT for approval. Once approved you will receive a temporary password, and you will be asked to approve a Microsoft Authenticator prompt before you can set your new password.

values.option: I think my account is compromised
I have Microsoft Authenticator on my phone and will approve the sign-in prompt

values.formSubmittedText: Thank you. Your request has been logged as an IT ticket and sent for approval. You will receive an email with your ticket number and next steps.

parameters.subject: =[{{ $('Create Dynamics Ticket').item.json.ticketnumber || 'No ticket' }}] New Microsoft 365 password change request logged
parameters.bodyContent:
=

A new Microsoft 365 password change request has been logged as a Dynamics 365 ticket.

Ticket / case number: {{ $('Create Dynamics Ticket').item.json.ticketnumber || 'not created - check the Dynamics connection' }}

Name: {{ $('Password Change Request Form').item.json['Full name'] }}
Work email: {{ $('Password Change Request Form').item.json['Work email'] }}
Reason: {{ $('Password Change Request Form').item.json.Reason }}
Comments: {{ $('Password Change Request Form').item.json.Comments || 'none' }}
Submitted: {{ $('Password Change Request Form').item.json.submittedAt }}

The user's Microsoft Authenticator registration is being checked now. If it passes, you will receive a separate email with Approve / Decline buttons. The ticket will be resolved and closed automatically once the request is finished, and you will get a confirmation email.

parameters.toRecipients: ={{ $('Look Up M365 User').item.json.otherMails?.[0] || $('Look Up M365 User').item.json.mail }}
parameters.subject: =[{{ $('Create Dynamics Ticket').item.json.ticketnumber || 'Request received' }}] We have logged your Microsoft 365 password change request
parameters.bodyContent:
=

Hi {{ $('Look Up M365 User').item.json.displayName }},

We have received your request to change your Microsoft 365 password and logged it as an IT ticket.

Your ticket / case number: {{ $('Create Dynamics Ticket').item.json.ticketnumber || 'n/a' }}

Your request is now waiting for IT approval. You will receive another email with next steps, and a final email when the ticket is resolved and closed. Please quote your ticket number if you contact IT about this request.

If you did not make this request, contact IT immediately.

parameters.subject: =[{{ $('Create Dynamics Ticket').item.json.ticketnumber || 'Approved' }}] Your Microsoft 365 password change has been approved
parameters.bodyContent:
=

Hi {{ $('Look Up M365 User').item.json.displayName }},

IT has approved your password change request (ticket {{ $('Create Dynamics Ticket').item.json.ticketnumber || 'n/a' }}).

Temporary password: {{ $('Build Temporary Password').item.json.tempPassword }}

  1. Go to office.com and sign in as {{ $('Look Up M365 User').item.json.userPrincipalName }} with the temporary password.
  2. Approve the sign-in request in Microsoft Authenticator on your phone.
  3. Choose your new password when prompted.

If you did not request this, contact IT immediately.

parameters.subject: =[{{ $('Create Dynamics Ticket').item.json.ticketnumber || 'Closed' }}] Your Microsoft 365 password change ticket has been resolved and closed
parameters.bodyContent:
=

Hi {{ $('Outcome').item.json.userName }},

Your IT ticket {{ $('Create Dynamics Ticket').item.json.ticketnumber || 'n/a' }} for a Microsoft 365 password change has been resolved and closed.

Outcome: {{ $('Outcome').item.json.outcomeLabel }}

{{ $('Outcome').item.json.userMessage }}

If this did not solve your problem, or you have any feedback about this process, reply to this email or contact IT and quote your ticket number.

If you did not request this, contact IT immediately.

nodeGroups.name: Log & create Dynamics ticket
nodeGroups.description: Logs the request, opens a Dynamics 365 case and emails the admin the case number

nodeGroups.name: Admin approval
nodeGroups.description: Emails the admin Approve/Decline buttons (with ticket number) and waits up to 24 hours

nodeGroups.name: Reset & notify user
nodeGroups.description: Sets a temp password that needs Authenticator MFA before the user picks a new one, emails the user, and records the outcome

nodeGroups.name: Declined
nodeGroups.description: Logs that the request was declined or timed out

nodeGroups.name: No Authenticator
nodeGroups.description: Logs the rejection when Authenticator is missing or the account is disabled

nodeGroups.name: User not found
nodeGroups.description: Logs the rejection when the email address has no Microsoft 365 account, so the ticket still gets closed

nodeGroups.name: Resolve & close Dynamics ticket
nodeGroups.description: For every outcome: notes it on the case, resolves and closes the case in Dynamics 365, and emails the admin and the user the result with the tick
